newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's First Deputy PM Potanin may resign.
newsitem.headline: Russia's First Deputy PM Potanin may resign.

text.p: Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister in charge of economic reforms, Vladimir Potanin, is likely to resign from the government, Interfax news agency quoted Potanin's spokeswoman as saying on Monday.
Earlier Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin announced several top cabinet appointments which did not include Potanin.
She said Potanin took this news quietly and after a meeting between President Boris Yeltsin and Chernomyrdin, where they decided on his fate, met the International Monetary Fund mission.
Before becoming First Deputy Prime Minister last year Potanin was president of Russia's fourth biggest bank, Uneximbank. The spokeswoman said he may return there.
She said Potanin may hold a news conference on Tuesday.
